sloka: बहून्वर्षगणान्ब्रह्मन्भुज्यमानमिदं मया ।क्षयं नाभ्येति ब्रह्मर्षे तृप्तिश्चापि ममोत्तमा ।। ७.७८.२२ ॥
transliteration: bahūnvarṣagaṇānbrahmanbhujyamānamidaṁ mayā ।kṣayaṁ nābhyeti brahmarṣe tṛptiścāpi mamottamā ।। 7.78.22 ॥

translations.english: O Brahmin, O Brahmarshi, though this body has been consumed by me for many years, it does not undergo destruction, and my satisfaction is also supreme.
